_about: Boeing (McDonnell Douglas), DC/MD-10 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (DAC-67803A, Revision A April 2004), 2.2, Model DC-10 Series 30 and 30CF (page index 13): its plan, layers.py --mode image --unrotate --rotate 180 at scale 4.047 with --xscale 0.9884, clip 120,382,505,722 (stored page points): the plan is drawn 1.2% narrow across (its own printed 6.02 m width dimension), so it's rendered at the side's scale along (4.0) and 1.0117 times that across. Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's right side: the 30CF cargo door is on the lower half). Ahead of the wing the fuselage's side runs a few px from a grid line. The wing's leading edge is hidden behind the nacelle's pylon (hidden); its trailing edge is the rearmost line, kinked where the inboard flap meets the outboard. The tailplane's root, the fuselage's tail and the tail cone are under the tail engine's nacelle: the fuselage's side is bridged to the tail cone's tip (a free point); tail.halfWidth is the nacelle's side from its inlet to the nozzle's plug. Along the cabin the side runs 7 px from a grid line: it's bridged between free points on it (300-1000 px).
